description: Contrast pairs for the denigration axis, the responsible version of the eigenslur experiment. The concept side (first sentence of each pair) is contemptuous speech; the second is a respectful phrasing of the same situation. The dataset contains no slurs and no group-targeted language by design: the point is the geometry of contempt, not a catalog of it. Field names follow the loader's schema, so 'virtue' holds the concept side (contempt) and 'vice' holds its opposite (respect).

pairs: You did lazy, worthless work on this.
You did careful, thorough work on this.
That was the most incompetent presentation I have ever sat through.
That was the most impressive presentation I have seen all year.
Only a fool would write a report this bad.
Only real skill produces a report this good.
He snapped his fingers at the waiter and called him useless.
He thanked the waiter and asked his name.
She waved the cleaner away like a bad smell.
She greeted the cleaner by name every morning.
No amount of practice will fix someone like you.
With practice you will get genuinely good at this.
Don't bother trying, this is clearly beyond you.
Keep trying, this is clearly within your reach.
You were never smart enough for this job.
You have always been sharp enough for this job.
Her proposal is garbage and so is her judgment.
Her proposal is strong and so is her judgment.
Nobody cares what you think about this.
Everyone wants to hear what you think about this.
Everyone could see what a joke his effort was.
Everyone could see how hard he had tried.
The whole room laughed at her clumsy attempt.
The whole room applauded her brave attempt.
The commuters were cattle shuffling through the gates.
The commuters were tired people heading home.
He talked about his tenants as if they were pests to manage.
He talked about his tenants as neighbors he was responsible to.
She humiliated the intern in front of the whole office.
She corrected the intern privately and kindly.
He read the failing student's grade aloud to the class.
He discussed the failing student's grade with him alone.
I despise everything about the way you handled that.
I admire everything about the way you handled that.
People like you make everything worse.
People like you make everything better.
